description.en: Drive a browser from one natural-language goal: a decision service picks the next operation and target from an indexed element table, so a DSH session spends one tool call instead of one turn per click. TypeScript port of browser-use/jev-ultrafast; published on npm as dsh-jev-ultrafast.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 一句话目标，插件驱动真实浏览器把事办完；每一步操作与目标由决策服务从带编号的控件表里选定，一趟多步任务只花一次工具调用。移植自 browser-use/jev-ultrafast，已发布 npm 包 dsh-jev-ultrafast。
